QuestInfo.name: Support for Lv. 50 Resistance members.
QuestInfo.0: #bCassandra#k is giving out gifts to Resistance members who've reached Lv. 50. Go see her once you reach Lv. 50.
QuestInfo.2: You received an item that will help your development, but it can't be used yet. You must wait until Jan 19.

0.0: I, Cassandra, am giving a special gift to Resistance members who have reached Level 50. Will you accept the gift?

yes.0: Come see me, Cassandra, at any of the nearest towns. I'll be waiting!

no.0: The gift event will be going on until Jan 18, so please come see me anytime.

1.0: This is a special bonus EXP item that will be available to all jobs starting #bJan 19#k. This item will help you gain EXP. You must remember to check the expiration date. Also keep in mind that you cannot use it more than #r7 times#k, which includes the number of Energy Capsules used. You can receive another gift when you reach Level 60, so try hard! Good luck!
